question: On Darwin, does Tips.configure([.datastoreLocation(.url(fileURL))]) create a Core Data / SQLite store at that URL before returning, and which TipKitError is thrown on a second configure?
reason: Linux configures an in-memory store once and throws tipsDatastoreAlreadyConfigured on the second call. URL and CloudKit options are recorded and inert; no file is created.

question: Does Darwin's cloudKitContainer(.automatic) / named(_:) synchronize event donations across devices, and what error is produced without a CloudKit entitlement?
reason: Linux records the option and never talks to CloudKit. Sync success would be fabricated.

question: Is Tips.DonationTimeRange.day a fixed 86400 seconds or a calendar day in the current time zone when filtering Sequence.donatedWithin?
reason: Linux treats named ranges as elapsed seconds. Darwin calendar semantics are unobserved.

question: What public initializer or #Rule macro expansion does Darwin emit for Tips.Rule, and are CompoundOperation conjunction/disjunction the only combinators?
reason: The graph has no public Rule init. Linux exposes SPI predicates only; #Rule is deferred.

question: Does Darwin store Action.label as a SwiftUI.Text closure even when the StringProtocol title init is used, and is title mapped 1:1 into Text?
reason: Linux implements only the StringProtocol init. The Text-labeled init is gated until real SwiftUI is on the compile line.

question: What is Darwin's default Tip.id when a conforming type does not implement it — String(describing: Self.self), String(reflecting: Self.self), or another stable key?
reason: Linux defaults to String(describing: Self.self) and uses the same string as the hideTipsForTesting / showTipsForTesting type key.

question: Does showAllTipsForTesting make an already-invalidated tip report Status.available, or only force shouldDisplay while status stays invalidated?
reason: Linux reports .available and shouldDisplay true so UI tests can still present invalidated tips. Darwin's status vs shouldDisplay split is unobserved.

question: Does TipGroup.Priority.firstAvailable pick a different tip than .ordered when several tips are eligible — for example by recency — or is it also first-in-builder-order?
reason: Linux uses the first shouldDisplay tip in builder order for both priorities because display-history ranking is unobserved.

question: When SwiftUI is present, are Tip.title / Tip.message / Tip.image the SwiftUI.Text and SwiftUI.Image nominal types rather than a TipKit overlay?
reason: Isolated Linux host has no SwiftUI; those members are omitted rather than substituted. EC2 identity probe must import SwiftUI and TipKit together.
